from speech_client import get_text_to_speech_client
from speech_models import SynthesisInput, VoiceSelectionParams, AudioConfig, SynthesizeSpeechRequest, SynthesizeSpeechResponse
from google.cloud import texttospeech

def synthesize_ssml(ssml_content: str, voice_name: str, language_code: str = "en-US") -> SynthesizeSpeechResponse:
    client = get_text_to_speech_client()

    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(ssml=ssml_content)
    voice_params = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(language_code=language_code, name=voice_name)
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3)

    response = client.synthesize_speech(input=synthesis_input, voice=voice_params, audio_config=audio_config)

    return SynthesizeSpeechResponse(audio_content=response.audio_content, content_type="audio/mpeg")

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate
import os

def translate_script(text: str, target_language: str, project_id: str = None) -> str:
    translate_client = translate.Client(project=project_id)

    if isinstance(text, bytes):
        text = text.decode("utf-8")

    # Text can also be a sequence of strings, in which case this method
    # will return a sequence of results for each text. (The `text` parameter can
    # also be a list of strings.)
    result = translate_client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)

    return result["translatedText"]

from google.cloud import aiplatform
import os

def get_text_embedding(text: str, project_id: str, location: str = "us-central1") -> list:
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # The model_id can vary, using a common one for text embeddings
    # Refer to Google Cloud Vertex AI documentation for available models and their IDs
    model_id = "textembedding-gecko@001"

    # Instantiate the TextEmbeddingModel
    model = aiplatform.gapic.PredictionServiceClient(client_options={
        "api_endpoint": f"{location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"
    })

    instance = {"content": text}
    instances = [instance]

    # The endpoint ID is typically derived from the model ID
    endpoint_id = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/publishers/google/models/{model_id}"

    response = model.predict(endpoint=endpoint_id, instances=instances)

    embeddings = []
    for prediction in response.predictions:
        # Assuming the embedding is directly accessible in the prediction dictionary
        if "embeddings" in prediction and "values" in prediction["embeddings"]:
            embeddings.append(prediction["embeddings"]["values"])
    return embeddings[0] if embeddings else []

from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech
import io
import os

def transcribe_audio_sample(audio_bytes: bytes, sample_rate_hertz: int, language_code: str = "en-US") -> str:
    client = speech.SpeechClient()

    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(content=audio_bytes)
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.MP3,
        sample_rate_hertz=sample_rate_hertz,
        language_code=language_code,
    )

    response = client.recognize(config=config, audio=audio)

    transcript = ""
    for result in response.results:
        transcript += result.alternatives[0].transcript

    return transcript
